q: The Gelfand-Pinsker theorem addresses channel coding with non-causal side information S at the encoder. The capacity is:
opts: max_{p(u|s),x(u,s)} I(U;Y) − I(U;S) where U is an auxiliary RV
exp: Gelfand-Pinsker capacity: C = max_{p(u,x|s)} [I(U;Y) − I(U;S)]. The auxiliary variable U encodes the message plus the known interference S. Costa's DPC is the Gaussian special case where the maximum equals ½ log(1+P/N), independent of the interference power.
